name: 01-ferry
notes: The browser scene's own replay golden, as a script the Godot host can be driven by. Transcribed from SCRIPT in web/lib/dialogue-scene/replay.test.ts: one run that rings the bell, takes the token and crosses, then a restart and a second run that asks the fare, waits by the door, and finds out what the branch does when neither flag holds. No seed and no step — a scenario has no clock, so a replay is a list of actions. The digest hashes the view as well as the state, because what is drawn is a pure function of the state and a change that moved one without the other would be a change in this genre's whole contract with its consumers. `.web-frames.txt` carries an `opening` line before step 0: the settle that reaches the first moment is a transition like any other and is hashed like one.
